The '''''Aurora''''' was a [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] helmed by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Teren Rogriss]], serving in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-aligned [[Kuati Sector Forces]]. As a part of the [[Sector/Legends|Sector]] Forces, the ''Aurora'' protected the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat's]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8.5 ABY]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the Galactic Empire and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During the [[Taking of Kuat]], the New Republic's forces seized the planet Kuat even with the protection of the Sector Forces. In [[Undercover attack on Kuat|response]] to the victory, Imperial agents hidden undercover activated the ''Aurora''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], sending it into Kuat's [[Kuat (star)|sun]] and destroying it.

==Description==
A massive [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]], the ''Aurora'' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==History==
The ''Aurora'' was part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-affiliated [[Kuati Sector Forces]]<ref name="Warfare" /> in [[8 ABY/Legends|8.5 ABY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], in which the Galactic Empire fought against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] for control of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Helmed by Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Teren Rogriss]], sent in from the current Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]], the ''Aurora'', along with the rest of the Kuati [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], guarded the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], home to [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], a key [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] for the Empire. Soon after the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|defeated]] the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Zsinj]], they launched an [[Taking of Kuat|attack]] against Kuat in hope of securing its shipyards.<ref name="Warfare" />

The Republic [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]] of [[Surprise Squadron]] took out the [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] [[Luminous (battlecruiser)|''Luminous'']] and three [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] using their [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion weaponry]] while a [[Coded eraser virus|virus]] caused the battlecruiser [[Event Horizon (battlecruiser)|''Event Horizon'']] and five [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyers]] to turn against the rest of the fleet. Facing an enemy that could take out nine [[Warship/Legends|warships]] in a matter of [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], Kuati officials were forced to surrender after Republic representative [[Ral'Rai Muvunc]] brought to light the fact that the New Republic controlled thirty-four percent of Kuati shares, while also informing them of the Republic [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]] that could be in the [[Kuat system/Legends|system]] in short [[Time/Legends|time]]. The Republic allowed Rogriss to relinquish command of the ''Aurora'' and take his crew back to Orinda. Shortly after the battle, Imperial undercover agents [[Undercover attack on Kuat|activated]] the ''Aurora''{{'s}} hyperdrive, sending it into Kuat's [[Kuat (star)|sun]] and destroying it.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Commanders and crew==
The ''Aurora'' was under the command of Imperial Admiral Terren Rogriss, who was sent from the Imperial-controlled [[Orinda system/Legends|Orinda system]] to Kuat to helm the ship. His command lasted until the Empire's defeat at Kuat, after which Rogriss and his crew were permitted to withdraw back to Orinda, leaving the ''Aurora'' at Kuat.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Aurora'' was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] released in [[2012]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" />
